purpose: One fixed fundamental/price interaction comparison; no model, threshold, horizon or capital-dependent cohort search

inputs_in_order.name: S
inputs_in_order.formula: Current original quarterly (NetIncomeLoss - same-original prior-year-quarter NetIncomeLoss) / exact prior-FY assets, divided by sample standard deviation of the eight earlier scheduled qualified Q1/Q2/Q3 innovations; frozen S methodology unchanged
inputs_in_order.source: Original accession facts available by the event decision; no later replacement

inputs_in_order.name: Q
inputs_in_order.source: Same-original exact USD entity-wide NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities and NetIncomeLoss; unique matching YTD periods and frozen qualification bounds

inputs_in_order.name: prior_relative_return_5
inputs_in_order.requirements: p is the last completed session before the09:00ET decision; all six closes for each instrument finite and positive; no forward fill

inputs_in_order.name: prior_dollar_activity_ratio_20
inputs_in_order.formula: vendor_quote_close[p] * vendor_quote_volume[p] / median(vendor_quote_close[j] * vendor_quote_volume[j] for j=p-20,...,p-1)
inputs_in_order.requirements: Twenty denominator sessions are consecutive and exclude the numerator session; all21same-row products finite with positive closes and nonnegative volumes; median strictly positive; preserve original price/volume unit identities

inputs_in_order.name: prior_spy_sma200_distance
inputs_in_order.requirements: All200consecutive prior-or-current completed-session closes finite and positive; no forward fill

feature_population.requirements: Original S feature, same-accession Q, original same-CIK event-header industry classification, execution clock, and all five causal numeric inputs must be qualified/finite. Keep the wider structural population and each missing-feature reason. No future price or label availability may affect test candidate eligibility.
feature_population.original_event_SIC: For every one of the five recipes, require one unambiguous numeric SIC in 0100-5999 or 7000-8999 from the event's ORIGINAL header FILER block bound to the exact event CIK. Exclude financial 6000-6999 and other out-of-range codes. Missing/conflicting/malformed SIC or unmatched/ambiguous filer-CIK linkage is unavailable. Never take the first flat SIC from a multi-filer document, substitute current submissions SIC, remove a preserved filing, or replace an issuer.
feature_population.prior_S_history_classification: The original-event SIC gate applies to the candidate event only. Frozen S arithmetic and its eight-earlier-event history remain unchanged; prior-industry changes or missing prior-header classification remain explicit limitations, not a hidden history rewrite.
feature_population.financial_vintage: Original first filing, strict clock, no amendments/later facts/modern companyfacts fallback
feature_population.price_vintage: Retrospective saved provider prices; raw source/adjustment identities retained, not point-in-time vendor vintages
feature_population.row_identity: One retained original event with CIK, symbol, accession, original filing/acceptance clocks, decision timestamp, entry session, planned exit session and source identities

outputs_in_order.name: downside_5
outputs_in_order.limitation: Close-sampled adverse movement, not intraday loss, a stop price, or a guaranteed maximum loss

label_requirements: e is the planned decision-day close entry; e+5 is the fifth subsequent official trading-session close. Fit/calibration rows require finite positive entry and every one of the five following closes, hence both finite targets. Preserve every unavailable/purged training row and reason. Test forecasts are produced before accessing test outcomes; missing test labels remain separately counted.

recipes.name: filing_control
recipes.rank: symbol ascending, accession ascending for an exact same-symbol tie

recipes.name: ridge
recipes.selection: Valid calibrated two-output forecast and strictly positive quantity-aware expected net-dollar utility
recipes.rank: Expected net-dollar utility descending under that account's current NAV, cash and cost profile; frozen deterministic symbol/accession tie order

recipes.name: hist_gradient_boosting
recipes.selection: Valid calibrated two-output forecast and strictly positive quantity-aware expected net-dollar utility
recipes.rank: Same utility and tie convention as ridge

models.preprocessing: Existing training-only SimpleImputer(strategy=median,add_indicator=True,keep_empty_features=True); StandardScaler for Ridge only. Shared population requires five finite inputs, so no missing financial values are admitted to obtain more rows. Fit all preprocessing exclusively on retained fitting rows.
models.targets: Two original fractional targets without target standardization, winsorization or clipping
models.fit_weights: One equal weight per retained original event; no outcome-based row sampling or resampling
models.model_family_selection: None: fit and retain both predeclared families independently in every eligible fold
models.forecast_sharing: Each family/year has one fitted model and one calibration shared across both balances and both fee profiles. Capital and fees only affect downstream sizing/utility, never training, preprocessing or calibration.
models.two_output_adapter: Use the existing fit helper with an n-by-2 target. Call the fitted model's predict and validate n-by-2 finite output. Do not call the existing six-head _targets/_family_prediction/predict_conditional wrappers or duplicate horizons to satisfy their shapes. Preserve raw unbounded model output separately from downside-clipped and calibrated output.

calibration.method: Per-output pooled mean residual from that fold's purged calibration rows only
steps: Preserve raw model predictions for both heads
Set uncalibrated downside=max(0,raw_downside); leave raw return unchanged
calibration.return_clip: None; a corrected return <=-1 is invalid for the existing utility planner and is retained as an abstention

chronology.partition_clock: 09:00ET decision timestamp, not a backward-assigned preceding close and not an earlier unverified earnings-release time
chronology.purging: Every fitting row's planned label-end session must precede the first calibration session; every calibration row's planned label-end session must precede the first test session. Use actual scheduled trading sessions. Retain the purged rows/reasons. Previous-year test events may enter a later year's calibration/fitting only when their outcomes are already available.
chronology.test_minimum_for_prediction: None: predict every causally eligible test event even if later outcomes are missing
chronology.insufficient_fold: No new entries for that learned family during the fold; preserve reason, row/issuer counts, warnings and sampled/source identities. No last-year-model reuse, alternate-family fallback, smaller window, relaxed sample gate or threshold change. Controls continue on their shared causal population. Existing holdings still follow their original scheduled exits.
chronology.fit_or_prediction_failure: Retain the failed model/fold attempt and abstain rather than substituting a profitable variant. Row-level invalid forecasts remain explicit; no candidate replacement at fill.
chronology.test_status: Exploratory historical research, not an untouched prospective holdout

accounts.cost_definition: Unchanged frozen proportional40bps round-trip scenario, or independently specified current Moomoo charges plus the same40bps execution scenario; exact tariff/code identities bound by final experiment definition. Not calibrated fills or an assertion of historical tariffs.
accounts.identical_new_entry_period: First official2021session through final official2025session for all20accounts;2017-2020supplies fit/cal only
accounts.liquidation_tail: Existing planned five-session exits may continue into January2026; retain cash/settlement marks through2026-01-16 and label the tail separately. Events with decision times in2026are outside the declared entry period, regardless of filing date.
accounts.state: One continuous cash/positions/reservations/settlement ledger per account, with no capital reset or forced flattening at model-year boundaries
accounts.entry_clock: Frozen post-filing public-availability floor;09:00ET decision using the preceding completed session's price/ATR and known settlements; hypothetical decision-session close fill
accounts.reservation_rule: Original fee-inclusive reservation is immutable; fill quantity may only decrease. Existing cash engine and historical settlement calendars apply. No fill-time reranking or replacement.
accounts.learned_utility: U=N*mu - buy_fee(q,N) - sell_fee(q,N*(1+mu)) - 0.5*N*downside; N=q*reference_price; require U>0 and valid mu>-1/downside>=0. Fee-inclusive quantity comes from the same cash/risk planner. Recheck frozen forecasts at the hypothetical fill price with no quantity increase; this is a simulated contingent-fill convention.
accounts.controls_fill_convention: Existing unconditional planned next-close fill sizing/reservation convention; no learned utility guard
accounts.missing_required_prices: Preserve invalid account status and the retained ledger prefix; never remove a candidate using its future entry or exit availability
accounts.drawdown_interpretation: Qualification limit, not a promise that a stop prevents30%loss. Report full observed drawdown and failures; no risk-limit relaxation to seek the owner's weekly return aspiration.

reporting: All 20 completed/invalid/failed account paths and fold abstentions
Primary 10k and paired 2k outcomes, costs, gross/net P&L, trade counts, exposure and settled cash
Weekly/monthly/yearly stability, drawdowns and issuer/trade profit concentration

All calendar weeks in the full-account evaluation interval, including idle and losing weeks: retain raw weekly series, exact fractions with returns >=5%, >=10% and >=15%, median/worst week and longest consecutive losing-week streak; never infer target-hit rates from annualized or aggregated returns. Label initialization and liquidation-tail weeks separately while preserving them.
Raw versus corrected per-head test errors against fitting-only mean-target baselines
Calibration-defined five prediction-quantile bins per head; collapse duplicate edges, retain test missing-outcome counts and report overlapping/clustered events
